description_of_nth_member: A purely geometric family (unit triangle, unit square, etc.) with no algebraic source. Used as a contrast — IsAlgebraicConstruction is FALSE for this family.
description: Coverage row: a non-algebraic family. Its instances point at PointSets that aren't projections of any lattice.
name: non-algebraic-baseline

description_of_nth_member: Project the first n short vectors of the Minkowski lattice of Q(sqrt(-3)) into R^2 via the embedding's first two real coordinates.
name: sqrt-lattice-projection

description_of_nth_member: Project the n smallest elements of Z[ζ_7] under σ_1 into R^2. The n=8 instance is the heptagon-with-center; larger n loads additional non-unit lattice elements (sums and differences). Sawin-style higher n configurations involve restricting to elements with controlled multi-σ norms — not loaded here.
name: q(ζ_7)-σ_1-projection
